Use case: ui-mockup. Create one polished full-screen 16:9 landscape GAME MENU CONCEPT ART image, not a multi-panel board, not a photograph of a monitor, not an editor screenshot. Original game: GALE BREAKER: ELEMENTAL CLASH. Input image 1 is a visual-language reference only: deep ink navy panels, refined thin gold outlines, restrained emerald selection glow, clean condensed ivory labels, elegant gold title lettering, painterly cel-shaded martial-arts fantasy. Input image 2 is the mandatory character identity reference: preserve each character's face, silhouette, outfit, hair, equipment and elemental color. Kaze has silver-white long ponytail, crimson headband, emerald shinobi vest. Ignis is a muscular adult woman with short spiky red hair, crimson practical armored brawler outfit, huge molten orange piston gauntlets. Tophia is an adult woman with black twin buns, imperial gold armored robes, floating stone monoliths. Volt has spiky yellow hair, cyan visor, cyan/white coat and plasma tonfas. No dark-haired Kaze, no male Ignis, no silver-haired Volt. Strong art direction, premium production concept, legible text, consistent padding, all UI inside safe screen margins. No watermark, no external brand names, no random small text. All text quoted below should be spelled exactly.
PRIMARY REQUEST: Design the MAIN MENU, an aspirational front-end screen for this game. Composition: a beautiful entire screen with stable readable navigation occupying left 34%, and a dramatic full-height painted ensemble illustration occupying the right 66%. Upper-left tasteful large gold logo on two lines exactly "GALE BREAKER" and below in spaced small caps "ELEMENTAL CLASH". Beneath the logo, six generous vertically stacked selectable rows exactly "ARCADE", "VERSUS LOCAL", "TREINO", "HABILIDADES", "OPÇÕES", "SAIR". ARCADE is selected, clearly emerald-filled with a slender gold edge and a small wind sigil; other rows dark translucent navy with subtle divider strokes. Add one brief quiet helper line below the selection list, exactly "Enfrente os mestres dos quatro elementos." Bottom-left tiny keyboard prompts exactly "W / S  NAVEGAR" and "ENTER  CONFIRMAR". Do not include fake online service badges, monetization, user currency, new mechanics or pop-up cards. Artwork: Kaze dominant in the right foreground, three-quarter grounded ready pose, flowing silver ponytail, headband ribbons and translucent emerald wind sweeping around the silhouette but never across menu text. Behind him arrange Ignis, Tophia and Volt at slightly smaller scale in a confident triangular ensemble, individually readable with flame, golden stone and cyan lightning accents. Background is the Zephyr mountain sanctuary: red torii architecture, blue mountains above clouds, pink cherry blossom trees and warm late-afternoon shafts of light. Fade painted scenery into a natural deep navy gradient underneath left navigation; no opaque full-screen black box. Gold and emerald balance, subordinate red/gold/cyan effects. Rich illustrative depth and local color, no excessive bloom. Show a finished coherent game screen ready to serve as a Godot implementation reference.
